verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-raa kitaabun uhkimat aayaatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun hakeemin khabeer
Allaa ta'budoo illaa Allaaha innanee lakum minhu nadheerun wa basheer
Wa anis-taghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumatti'kum mataa'an hasanan ilaa ajalin musamman wa yu'ti kulla dhee fadlin fadlahu wa in tawallaw fa-innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin kabeer
Ilaa Allaahi marji'ukum wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Alaa innahum yathnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minhu alaa heena yastaghshoona thiyaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoona innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Wa maa min daabbatin fil-ardi illaa alaa Allaahi rizquhaa wa ya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wa mustawda'ahaa kullun fee kitaabin mubeen

Wa huwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin wa kaana arshuhu alal-maa'i liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amalan wa la-in qulta innakum mab'oothoona min ba'dil-mawti layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrun mubeen
Wa la-in akhkharnaa anhumul-adhaaba ilaa ummatin ma'doodatin layaqoolunna maa yahbisuhu alaa yawma ya'teehim laysa masroofan anhum wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Wa la-in adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan thumma naza'naahaa minhu innahu laya'oosun kafoor
Wa la-in adhaqnaahu na'maa'a ba'da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna dhahabas-sayyi'aatu annee innahu lafarihun fakhoor
Illal-ladheena sabaroo wa amilus-saalihaati ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabeer
Fala'allaka taarikun ba'da maa yoohaa ilayka wa daa'iqun bihi sadruka an yaqooloo lawlaa unzila alayhi kanzun aw jaa'a ma'ahu malakun innamaa anta nadheerun Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in wakeel
Am yaqooloona iftaraahu qul fa'too bi-ashri suwarin mithlihi muftarayaatin wad'oo manis-tata'tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa-illam yastajeeboo lakum fa'lamoo annamaa unzila bi-ilmi Allaahi wa an laa ilaaha illaa huwa fahal antum muslimoon
Man kaana yureedul-hayaatad-dunyaa wa zeenatahaa nuwaffi ilayhim a'maalahum feehaa wa hum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena laysa lahum fil-aakhirati illan-naaru wa habita maa sana'oo feehaa wa baatilun maa kaanoo ya'maloon

Afaman kaana alaa bayyinatin min rabbihi wa yatloohu shaahidun minhu wa min qablihi kitaabu moosaa imaaman wa rahmatan ulaa'ika yu'minoona bihi wa man yakfur bihi minal-ahzaabi fan-naaru maw'iduhu falaa takun fee miryatin minhu innahul-haqqu min rabbika wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Wa man azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban ulaa'ika yu'radoona alaa rabbihim wa yaqoolul-ashhaadu haa'ulaa'il-ladheena kadhaboo alaa rabbihim alaa la'natu Allaahi alaz-zaalimeen
Al-ladheena yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi wa yabghoonahaa iwajan wa hum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Ulaa'ika lam yakoonoo mu'jizeena fil-ardi wa maa kaana lahum min doonillaahi min awliyaa'a yudaa'afu lahumul-adhaabu maa kaanoo yastatee'oonas-sam'a wa maa kaanoo yubsiroon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Laa jarama annahum fil-aakhirati humul-akhsaroon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa akhbatoo ilaa rabbihim ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon
Mathalul-fareeqayni kal-a'maa wal-asammi wal-baseeri was-samee'i hal yastawiyaani mathalan afalaa tadhakkaroon
Wa laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihi innee lakum nadheerun mubeen
An laa ta'budoo illaa Allaaha innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin aleem

Faqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihi maa naraaka illaa basharan mithlanaa wa maa naraaka ittaba'aka illal-ladheena hum araadhilunaa baadiyar-ra'yi wa maa naraa lakum alaynaa min fadlin bal nazunnukum kaadhibeen
Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu alaa bayyinatin min rabbee wa aataanee rahmatan min indihi fa-ummiyat alaykum anulzimukumoohaa wa antum lahaa kaarihoon
Wa yaaqawmi laa as'alukum alayhi maalan in ajriya illaa alaa Allaahi wa maa anaa bitaaridil-ladheena aamanoo innahum mulaaqoo rabbihim wa laakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
Wa yaaqawmi man yansurunee mina Allaahi in taradtuhum afalaa tadhakkaroon

Wa laa aqoolu lakum indee khazaa'inu Allaahi wa laa a'lamul-ghayba wa laa aqoolu innee malakun wa laa aqoolu lilladheena tazdaree a'yunukum lan yu'tiyahumu Allaahu khayran Allaahu a'lamu bimaa fee anfusihim innee idhan laminaz-zaalimeen
Qaaloo yaa noohu qad jaadaltanaa fa-aktharta jidaalanaa fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala innamaa ya'teekum bihi Allaahu in shaa'a wa maa antum bimu'jizeen
Wa laa yanfa'ukum nushee in aradtu an ansaha lakum in kaana Allaahu yureedu an yughwiyakum huwa rabbukum wa ilayhi turja'oon
Am yaqooloona iftaraahu qul inif-taraytuhu fa-alayya ijraamee wa anaa baree'un mimmaa tujrimoon
Wa oohiya ilaa noohin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illaa man qad aamana falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon
Wasna'il-fulka bi-a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa wa laa tukhaatibnee fil-ladheena zalamoo innahum mughraqoon
Wa yasna'ul-fulka wa kullamaa marra alayhi mala'un min qawmihi sakhiroo minhu qaala in taskharoo minnaa fa-innaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
Fasawfa ta'lamoona man ya'teehi adhaabun yukhzeehi wa yahillu alayhi adhaabun muqeem
Hattaa idhaa jaa'a amrunaa wa faarat-tannooru qulnaa ihmil feehaa min kullin zawjayni ithnayni wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa alayhil-qawlu wa man aamana wa maa aamana ma'ahu illaa qaleel
Wa qaalar-kaboo feehaa bismillaahi majraahaa wa mursaahaa inna rabbee laghafoorun Raheem
Wa hiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kal-jibaali wa naadaa noohun ibnahu wa kaana fee ma'zilin yaa bunayya irkab ma'anaa wa laa takun ma'al-kaafireen
Qaala sa'aawee ilaa jabalin ya'simunee minal-maa'i qaala laa aasimal-yawma min amrillaahi illaa man rahima wa haala baynahumal-mawju fakaana minal-mughraqeen
Wa qeela yaa ardub-la-ee maa'aki wa yaa samaa'u aqli'ee wa gheedal-maa'u wa qudiyal-amru wastawat alal-joodiyyi wa qeela bu'dan lilqawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa naadaa noohun rabbahu faqaala rabbi innab-nee min ahlee wa inna wa'dakal-haqqu wa anta ahkamul-haakimeen
Qaala yaa noohu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu amalun ghayru saalihin falaa tas'alni maa laysa laka bihi ilmun innee a'izuka an takoona minal-jaahileen
Qaala rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihi ilmun wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamnee akun minal-khaasireen
Qeela yaa noohuh-bit bisalaamin minnaa wa barakaatin alayka wa alaa umamin mimman ma'aka wa umamun sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum minnaa adhaabun aleem
Tilka min anbaa'il-ghaybi nooheehaa ilayka maa kunta ta'lamuhaa anta wa laa qawmuka min qabli haadhaa fasbir innal-aaqibata lilmuttaqeen
Wa ilaa aadin akhaahum hoodan qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu in antum illaa muftaroon
Yaa qawmi laa as'alukum alayhi ajran in ajriya illaa alal-ladhee fataranee afalaa ta'qiloon
Wa yaa qawmi istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursilis-samaa'a alaykum midraaran wa yazidkum quwwatan ilaa quwwatikum wa laa tatawallaw mujrimeen
Qaaloo yaa hoodu maa ji'tanaa bibayyinatin wa maa nahnu bitaarikee aalihatinaa an qawlika wa maa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
In naqoolu illa-taraaka ba'du aalihatinaa bisoo'in qaala innee ushhidu Allaaha washhadoo annee baree'un mimmaa tushrikoon
Min doonihi fakeedoonee jamee'an thumma laa tunziroon
Innee tawakkaltu alaa Allaahi rabbee wa rabbikum maa min daabbatin illaa huwa aakhidhun binaasiyatihaa inna rabbee alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum maa ursiltu bihi ilaykum wa yastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum wa laa tadurroonahu shay'an inna rabbee alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
Wa lammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa hoodan wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minnaa wa najjaynaahum min adhaabin ghaleez
Wa tilka aadun jahadoo bi-aayaati rabbihim wa asaw rusulahu wattaba'oo amra kulli jabbaarin aneed
Wa utbi'oo fee haadhihid-dunyaa la'natan wa yawmal-qiyaamati alaa inna aadan kafaroo rabbahum alaa bu'dan li-aadin qawmi hood

Wa ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihan qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu huwa ansha'akum minal-ardi wasta'marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee qareebun mujeeb
Qaaloo yaa saalihu qad kunta feenaa marjuwwan qabla haadhaa atanhaanaa an na'buda maa ya'budu aabaa'uunaa wa innanaa lafee shakkin mimmaa tad'oonaa ilayhi mureeb
Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu alaa bayyinatin min rabbee wa aataanee minhu rahmatan faman yansurunee mina Allaahi in asaytuhu famaa tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseer
Wa yaa qawmi haadhihi naaqatu Allaahi lakum aayatan fadharoohaa ta'kul fee ardi Allaahi wa laa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum adhaabun qareeb
Fa-aqaroohaa faqaala tamatta'oo fee daarikum thalaathata ayyaamin dhaalika wa'dun ghayru makdhoob
Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa saalihan wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minnaa wa min khizyi yawmi'idhin inna rabbaka huwal-qawiyyul-azeez
Wa akhadhal-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa-asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
Ka'an lam yaghnaw feehaa alaa inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum alaa bu'dan lithamood
Wa laqad jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun famaa labitha an jaa'a bi-ijlin haneedh
Falammaa ra'aa aydiyahum laa tasilu ilayhi nakirahum wa awjasa minhum kheefatan qaaloo laa takhaf innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmi loot
Wamra'atuhu qaa'imatun fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa bi-ishaaqa wa min waraa'i ishaaqa ya'qoob
Qaalat yaa waylataa a'alidu wa anaa ajoozun wa haadhaa ba'lee shaykhan inna haadhaa lashay'un ajeeb
Qaaloo ata'jabeena min amrillaahi rahmatu Allaahi wa barakaatuhu alaykum ahlal-bayti innahu hameedun majeed
Falammaa dhahaba an ibraaheemar-raw'u wa jaa'athul-bushraa yujaadilunaa fee qawmi loot
Inna ibraaheema lahaleemun awwaahun muneeb
Yaa ibraaheemu a'rid an haadhaa innahu qad jaa'a amru rabbika wa innahum aateehim adhaabun ghayru mardood
Wa lammaa jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wa daaqa bihim dhar'an wa qaala haadhaa yawmun aseeb

Wa jaa'ahu qawmuhu yuhra'oona ilayhi wa min qablu kaanoo ya'maloonas-sayyi'aati qaala yaa qawmi haa'ulaa'i banaatee hunna atharu lakum fattaqoo Allaaha wa laa tukhzoonee fee dayfee alaysa minkum rajulun rasheed
Qaaloo laqad alimta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqqin wa innaka lata'lamu maa nureed
Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aawee ilaa ruknin shadeed

Qaaloo yaa lootu innaa rusulu rabbika lan yasiloo ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqit'in minal-layli wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadun illam-ra'ataka innahu museebuhaa maa asaabahum inna maw'idahumus-subhu alaysas-subhu biqareeb
Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa ja'alnaa aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtarnaa alayhaa hijaaratan min sijjeelin mandood
Musawwamatan inda rabbika wa maa hiya minaz-zaalimeena biba'eed

Wa ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'ayban qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu wa laa tanqusul-mikyaa la wal-meezaana innee araakum bikhayrin wa innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin muheet
Wa yaa qawmi awful-mikyaala wal-meezaana bil-qisti wa laa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum wa laa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Baqiyyatu Allaahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'mineena wa maa anaa alaykum bihafeez
Qaaloo yaa shu'aybu asalaatuka ta'muruka an natruka maa ya'budu aabaa'uunaa aw an naf'ala fee amwaalinaa maa nashaa'u innaka la-antal-haleemur-rasheed

Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu alaa bayyinatin min rabbee wa razaqanee minhu rizqan hasanan wa maa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maa anhaakum anhu in ureedu illal-islaaha mas-tata'tu wa maa tawfeeqee illaa Billaahi alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi uneeb
Wa yaa qawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqee an yuseebakum mithlu maa asaaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma saalihin wa maa qawmu lootin minkum biba'eed
Wastaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee Raheemun wadood
Qaaloo yaa shu'aybu maa nafqahu katheeran mimmaa taqoolu wa innaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefan wa lawlaa rahtuka larajamnaaka wa maa anta alaynaa bi-azeez
Qaala yaa qawmi arahtee a'azzu alaykum mina Allaahi wattakhadhtumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyan inna rabbee bimaa ta'maloona muheet
Wa yaa qawmi i'maloo alaa makaanatikum innee aamilun sawfa ta'lamoona man ya'teehi adhaabun yukhzeehi wa man huwa kaadhibun wartaqiboo innee ma'akum raqeeb
Wa lammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa shu'ayban wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu birahmatin minnaa wa akhadhatil-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa-asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
Ka'an lam yaghnaw feehaa alaa bu'dan limadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
Wa laqad arsalnaa moosaa bi-aayaatinaa wa sultaanin mubeen
Ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi fattaba'oo amra fir'awna wa maa amru fir'awna birasheed
Yaqdumu qawmahu yawmal-qiyaamati fa-awradahumun-naara wa bi'sal-wirdul-mawrood
Wa utbi'oo fee haadhihi la'natan wa yawmal-qiyaamati bi'sar-rifdul-marfood
Dhaalika min anbaa'il-quraa naqussuhu alayka minhaa qaa'imun wa haseed
Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin zalamoo anfusahum famaa aghnat anhum aalihatuhumul-latee yad'oona min doonillaahi min shay'in lammaa jaa'a amru rabbika wa maa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
Wa kadhalika akhdhu rabbika idhaa akhadhal-quraa wa hiya zaalimatun inna akhdhahu aleemun shadeed
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liman khaafa adhaabal-aakhirati dhaalika yawmun majmoo'un lahun-naasu wa dhaalika yawmun mashhood
Wa maa nu'uakhkhiruhu illaa li'jalin ma'dood
Yawma ya'ti laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi-idhnihi faminhum shaqiyyun wa sa'eed
Fa-ammal-ladheena shaqoo fafin-naari lahum feehaa zafeerun wa shaheeq
Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuka inna rabbaka fa-aalun limaa yureed
Wa ammal-ladheena su'idoo fafil-jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuka ataa'an ghayra majdhoodh
Falaa taku fee miryatin mimmaa ya'budu haa'ulaa'i maa ya'budoona illaa kamaa ya'budu aabaa'uuhum min qablu wa innaa lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feehi wa lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wa innahum lafee shakkin minhu mureeb
Wa inna kullaa lammaa layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka a'maalahum innahu bimaa ya'maloona khabeer
Fastaqim kamaa umirta wa man taaba ma'aka wa laa tatghaw innahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Wa laa tarkanoo ilal-ladheena zalamoo fatamassakumun-naaru wa maa lakum min doonillaahi min awliyaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
Wa aqimis-salaata tarafayin-nahaari wa zulafan minal-layli innal-hasanaati yudhhibnas-sayyi'aati dhaalika dhikraa lidh-dhaakireen
Wasbir fa-innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
Falawlaa kaana minal-qurooni min qablikum uloo baqiyyatin yanhawna anil-fasaadi fil-ardi illaa qaleelan mimman anjaynaa minhum wattaba'al-ladheena zalamoo maa utrifoo feehi wa kaanoo mujrimeen
Wa maa kaana rabbuka liyuhlikal-quraa bizulmin wa ahluhaa muslihoon
Wa law shaa'a rabbuka laja'alan-naasa ummatan waahidatan wa laa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen
Illaa man rahima rabbuka wa lidhalika khalaqahum wa tammat kalimatu rabbika la-amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
Wa kullan naqussu alayka min anbaa'ir-rusuli maa nuthabbitu bihi fu'uaadaka wa jaa'aka fee haadhihil-haqqu wa maw'izatun wa dhikraa lilmu'mineen
Wa qul lilladheena laa yu'minoona i'maloo alaa makaanatikum innaa aamiloon
Wantaziroo innaa muntaziroon
Wa Lillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ilayhi yurja'ul-amru kulluhu fa'budhu wa tawakkal alayhi wa maa rabbuka bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
